method.question: which of the executed cells produced a trained model
method.loss_source: <results_root>/<job>/train_log.csv, column loss_epoch_1 (mean over epoch 1, not the final loss). loss_source is 'model.history' (mlp) or "model.metrics['loss']" (windowed variants).
method.error_convention: MSE is compared with MSE. The compiled loss is tf.keras.losses.MeanSquaredError in the six variants trained by gradient descent (frozen/models/networks/multilayer.py, conv1d.py, conv2d.py, lstm.py, mha.py and frozen/runner/networks_ctx.py), so loss_epoch_1 is an MSE even where the variant reports the per-record error as RMSE (conv1d, conv2d, lstm, mha and mlp_deep_ctx store RMSE in ae_errors.npy; mlp and mlp_ctx store MSE). The RMSE/MSE convention affects ae_errors.npy and the fused score, NOT the loss audited here.
method.floor: MSE of the constant predictor = per-feature mean of the min-max scaled training stretch. floor(g) = mean_{f in g} Var(x_scaled[:, f]), with x_scaled = (x - min)/(max - min + 1e-16) and min/max taken over the SAME stretch, as train() of frozen/models/networks/*.py does. Evaluated as Var(x_raw[:, f]) / (max_f - min_f + 1e-16)^2 so that the scaled matrix is never materialised.
method.row_range: regions.ae_train of each config.json (never assumed to be [50000, 200000)): it is [50000, 200000) in the 8 KNAD/CIC streams and [50000, 72264) in ACI-IoT-2023, where the corrected training cut is the whole day of 31 October (feature map 50,000 + autoencoders 22,264). Using [50000, 200000) on ACI would have put evaluation rows into the floor.
method.targets: The training targets are exactly the rows of the stretch in the three windowing schemes: create_windowed_data (TSR) maps y = window[-1] = x[j]; create_windowed_data_ar (AR) maps y = full_x[j+L] = x[j] (only the INPUT changes, not the target); and multilayer.py trains fit(x, x). The floor is therefore identical for AR and TSR.
method.feature_groups: fm_stats.json['feature_map'] of each job (it depends on the dataset, k, the grouping and the partition seed).
method.floor_cache: one read per (stream_key, ae_train): the per-column vector of scaled variances is cached and the floor of each group is the mean of its columns. It does not depend on the variant.
method.t4e: The 4 gradient-trained jobs of T4-E are audited with the CONTAMINATED stretch rebuilt in memory (x[start:start+B] = x[donor], frozen/runner/run_job.py and instrument.py), verified against regions.t4e_training_contamination.x_block_sha256_after.
method.floor_code: x = np.load(CACHE/<stream_key>/x.npy, mmap_mode='r'); seg = np.asarray(x[a:b], np.float64); mn, mx = seg.min(0), seg.max(0); v = seg.var(0) / (mx - mn + 1e-16)**2; floor[g] = float(np.mean(v[feature_map[g]]))  # checked against the brute-force mean((xs - xs.mean(0))**2) over the scaled matrix, |diff| < 1.4e-17

degeneracy.definition: group with floor < 0.001: after the min-max scaling of the training stretch its columns are almost constant (outliers stretch the range), so the constant predictor makes almost no error and the ratio blows up without saying anything about learning.
